conclusion: ENHANCED_CASE_BASE is the MOST metadata-rich of the four case banks, with higher coverage of optional fields (FormulaReference 18%, DecisionTreeReference 28%, CommonTrapReference 29%) than the certified bases. It has exactly the same systematic gaps as BASE2/4/5: (1) ExplanationVersion universally missing, (2) Exhibit Purpose universally missing, (3) one case per file missing context fields. The certification path requires closing P0 gaps then executing CAQS §1.6 verification. Schema structure is fully consistent with the certified bases — no structural migration needed.
